generate_gmock_classes: run gmock_class.py on a C++ header file to generate Google Mock classes for all classes
generate_gmock_for_class: run gmock_class.py on a header file with a specific class name to generate only that mock
render_cpp_type: use _RenderType to convert a C++ AST type node into a readable string with templates and modifiers
generate_mock_methods: use _GenerateMethods to emit MOCK_METHOD macro calls for all virtual functions in a class AST node
escape_macro_argument: use _EscapeForMacro to wrap a string in parentheses if it contains unbalanced commas for C++ macro safety
